name: Alternate Assist Mod
description: Exclusive adaptive Ship straight-fly controller. Manual clicks arm the stabilizer; feedback control independently selects press/release to minimize vertical velocity.

assist-enabled.name: Enable Ship Assist
assist-enabled.description: When enabled, your physical presses/clicks arm the stabilizer. In Exclusive Ship Control mode, raw click timing is not sent to Ship movement; the controller independently selects press/release from measured vertical velocity.

exclusive-control.name: Exclusive Ship Control (Straight Fly)
exclusive-control.description: ON: physical clicks only arm/maintain assist; raw click timing is consumed and the stabilizer independently controls Ship press/release while armed. OFF: legacy behavior forwards physical input and only adds corrections in released gaps.

straightness.name: Straightness
straightness.description: Main straight-fly precision control. Higher values sharply reduce tolerated gravity-relative vertical velocity. 100 targets an ultra-tight horizontal velocity band.

max-cps.name: Maximum CPS
max-cps.description: Maximum automatic full press/release cycles per second. This controls the stabilizer output, not your physical click speed. The actual limit is also bounded by the game's physics update rate.

target-vertical-velocity.name: Target Vertical Velocity
target-vertical-velocity.description: Target gravity-relative vertical velocity. 0 targets horizontal flight; positive/negative values allow a controlled slow drift.

manual-activity-window.name: Manual Activity Window
manual-activity-window.description: How long the stabilizer stays armed after the most recent physical press/release. Your clicks only keep assistance active; they do not determine the automatic pulse rhythm.

input-alignment.name: Manual Click Alignment
input-alignment.description: Optional influence of your recent click rate on the velocity tolerance only. It never synchronizes automatic press/release timing to your physical clicks. Set to 0 for fully click-independent correction.

manual-resume-delay.name: Correction Resume Delay
manual-resume-delay.description: Optional delay before the controller resumes after a physical release. Use 0 for immediate straight-fly correction.

route-player2-jump-to-player1.name: Route Player 2 Jump to Player 1 in Single-Player
route-player2-jump-to-player1.description: Compatibility option for keymaps where Up Arrow is bound to Jump P2. In non-dual levels, routes P2 primary jump input to Player 1 so Up Arrow controls your Ship. Automatically leaves P2 untouched in dual mode.

player2-enabled.name: Enable Player 2 Assist
player2-enabled.description: Enables the same controller for Player 2 in dual mode. Disabled by default.

debug-telemetry.name: Debug Controller Telemetry
debug-telemetry.description: Logs vertical velocity, predicted velocity, desired controller output, exclusive-control state, physics hook calls, and physical input event count.
